174K likes, 206 comments - natgeo on October 19, 2026: "Photographing a big cat in the wild can take months of planning, with no guarantee of getting the shot. National Geographic photographer @stevewinterphoto has spent decades finding ways to capture these elusive animals, often using camera traps and working with people who know their habitats. 

Head to the link in bio to learn more about the efforts to protect them.".
